from sympy import asin, pi, Rational, simplify
th=2*asin(Rational(7,2)/7)
arc=simplify(7*th)
opts={'A':Rational(7,6)*pi,'B':Rational(7,4)*pi,'C':Rational(8,3)*pi,'D':Rational(7,3)*pi}
assert simplify(arc-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert simplify(arc-opts[k])!=0

for k in 'ABD': assert dist!=opts[k]
